subject: general
question: Select the correct option to fill blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**light**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**light**" refers to the illumination provided by the clock's display. In this context, it denotes the green fluorescent display showing the time. (प्रकाश)
 
• The other options, "**hands**," "**points**," and "**dial**," do not fit the context of the sentence as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Twelve o'clock the green fluorescent light__ of his clock read.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hands (सुइयाँ)**: refer to the pointers on a clock that indicate the time.
 
• **Points (बिंदु)**: refer to specific locations or detailed aspects of something.
 
• **Dial (डायल)**: refers to the face of a clock where the numbers and hands are displayed.
